atlas-sfp-testing/atlas-sfp-testing.md::.reason: Atlas Serverless and Fault Proxy guidance has no portable machine fixture corpus and needs an explicit prose-only outcome.

benchmarking/benchmarking.md::document.reason: The benchmarking specification defines workload guidance rather than a portable pass/fail fixture corpus and needs an explicit prose-only outcome.

bson-binary-encrypted/binary-encrypted.m.reason: Encrypted BSON subtype behavior depends on the pending client-side encryption design and cryptographic runtime boundary.

bson-binary-uuid/uuid.md::document.reason: Lua has no standard native UUID type, so the representation rules need an explicit applicability classification.

bson-decimal128/decimal128.md::document.reason: Deterministic Decimal128 interchange and exact numeric behavior are covered by the exact-value unit vectors.

bson-objectid/objectid.md::counter-rollo.reason: A deterministic generator vector covers the 24-bit counter rollover from 0xffffff to zero.

bson-objectid/objectid.md::post-fork-ran.reason: A deterministic fake-runtime vector changes process identity and proves that the first child ObjectId consumes a fresh five-byte process value while retaining the wrapping counter.

bson-objectid/objectid.md::timestamp-bou.reason: Deterministic runtime vectors cover timestamps 0x00000000, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, and 0xffffffff as unsigned big-endian values.

collation/collation.md::document.reason: Command builders preserve collation documents and enforce the negotiated unacknowledged-write restrictions.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::client-opt.reason: The five pinned URI-option cases and deterministic programmatic vectors cover ordered compressors, unknown-name warnings, defaults, and every zlib compression level from -1 through 9.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::framing-an.reason: Byte-exact vectors cover opcode 2012, the original opcode, the header-excluding uncompressed size, compressor ID, and compression failures.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::handshake-.reason: Each connection advertises only available configured compressors in client order, selects the first client-preferred overlap, tolerates no overlap, and does not renegotiate after its initial handshake.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::prohibited.reason: The exact case-insensitive command matrix keeps hello, legacy hello, authentication, user-management, and copydb authentication commands uncompressed while allowing ordinary commands.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::response-d.reason: Deterministic vectors select each response provider by envelope ID, accept ordinary or compressed replies including the initial hello, and reject unknown IDs, malformed sizes, oversized frames, and provider failures.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::sharded-ro.reason: Every sharded compatibility row enables zlib on the public client before exercising commands, indexes, sessions, and transactions through a real mongos.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::snappy-cod.reason: An exact raw Snappy vector covers compressor ID 1 and a TCP integration round trip verifies negotiated OP_COMPRESSED framing.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::standalone.reason: Every standalone and replica-set compatibility row enables zlib before a public-client ping against its pinned live MongoDB server.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::unavailabl.reason: Public-client integration cases omit unavailable Snappy and Zstandard providers from the handshake and expose one credential-free warning for each configured codec.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::zlib-codec.reason: Exact vectors cover compressor ID 2 and every supported zlib compression level, while invalid input returns a structured protocol failure.

compression/OP_COMPRESSED.md::zstandard-.reason: An exact Zstandard frame vector covers compressor ID 3 and a TCP integration round trip verifies negotiated OP_COMPRESSED framing.

dbref/dbref.md::document.reason: The driver preserves DBRef-shaped BSON documents but exposes no class-style DBRef abstraction, so applicability needs an explicit classification.

enumerate-collections/enumerate-collecti.reason: Deterministic admin and topology vectors verify primary selection plus standalone, replica-set primary, directly connected replica-set secondary, and mongos routing.

enumerate-databases/enumerate-databases..reason: Deterministic admin and topology vectors verify primary selection plus standalone, replica-set primary, directly connected replica-set secondary, and mongos routing.

extended-json/extended-json.md::document.reason: Canonical and relaxed Extended JSON conversion is covered by deterministic ordered-value unit vectors.

find_getmore_killcursors_commands/find_g.reason: Find, getMore, killCursors, exhaustion, and cleanup are covered at deterministic command and transport boundaries.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::bucket-configurat.reason: Deterministic public and unified-adapter vectors cover immutable bucket names, chunk sizes, concerns, preferences, timeouts, and the disableMD5 compatibility no-op without database I/O.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::bucket-drop.reason: Bucket drop removes only the configured files collection and then chunks collection under one operation timeout and stops on the first failure.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::chunked-upload-st.reason: Upload-stream vectors cover exact chunk boundaries, final partial chunks, per-file overrides, metadata, custom ids, terminal close, and structured write failures without orphan cleanup.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::delete-by-id.reason: Deletion vectors remove the files document before chunks, optionally clean orphan chunks, and return the GridFS not-found error for a missing file.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::delete-by-name.reason: Filename deletion discovers every revision id, removes only those files before their chunks, and returns the GridFS not-found error when no revision exists.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::download-streams.reason: Download streams cover exact bytes, bounded reads, seek and tell, zero-length files, numeric field variants, missing files, and required chunk ordering and length validation.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::download-to-strea.reason: Destination-copy vectors preserve exact byte order and the first structured read, write, or cleanup failure without closing the caller-owned destination.
Named destination-copy vectors select the requested revision and share one timeout across lookup and chunks without closing the caller-owned destination.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::filename-revision.reason: Filename downloads select positive revisions oldest-first and negative revisions newest-first and distinguish a missing filename from an out-of-range revision.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::files-find.reason: Find returns a cursor-like iterable and forwards the filter, all GridFS find options, concerns, preference, and the cursor-lifetime timeout without filter validation.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::readable-stream-u.reason: Readable-source uploads preserve caller ownership and apply one timeout context across index discovery, chunk writes, and the final files insert.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::rename-by-id.reason: Rename-by-id changes only the selected files document filename and returns the GridFS not-found error when the id is absent.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::rename-by-name.reason: Rename-by-name changes every matching revision and no other files and returns the GridFS not-found error when the filename is absent.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::required-indexes-.reason: The first bucket write lazily compares and creates both required indexes, while an empty upload stores one zero-length files document and no chunks.

gridfs/gridfs-spec.md::upload-abort.reason: Abort removes written chunks, omits the files document, closes the stream, rejects later writes, and preserves a cleanup failure.

logging/logging.md::document.reason: Standardized driver logging remains owned by the additional observability activity.

message/OP_MSG.md::document.reason: Kind-0 and kind-1 payloads, flags, framing limits, and response correlation are covered by the OP_MSG unit vectors.

ocsp-support/ocsp-support.md::document.reason: LuaSec 1.3 does not expose certificate revocation, OCSP stapling, or OCSP endpoint verification, and this driver will not add a separate OCSP implementation.

polling-srv-records-for-mongos-discovery.reason: All thirteen prose polling cases run against deterministic DNS, clock, and topology adapters.

server_write_commands/server_write_comma.reason: Insert, update, delete, ordered batching, and acknowledged error shapes are covered by deterministic command vectors.

socks5-support/socks5.md::document.reason: This driver will not implement SOCKS5 proxy options, authentication, or transport forwarding.
